Mid-morning, tribute to our newest handler
The new month is here
Careful paws, steady plans

At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk is keeping preparations calm, clear, and kind as more families set out with their companions. <<FACT F047>> Our passenger coordinators are guiding travelers through the required steps, while the welcome team readies each boarding area with quiet attention to detail.

When concerns arise, supervisors are listening closely and responding with practical support, because a smooth journey begins long before takeoff. Staff across the operation are working in close step to help each animal travel safely and each traveler feel informed. We appreciate the steady teamwork across Aurelia Skyways, and we remain committed to respectful care at every stage of the journey.
